bind_address.description: IPv4 address to bind for incoming DNS queries (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for loopback only, or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

bind_address_ipv6.description: IPv6 address to bind for incoming DNS queries (e.g., '::' for all interfaces, or '::1' for loopback only). Set to '' to disable IPv6.

port.description: UDP/TCP port to listen for DNS queries.

threads.description: Number of worker threads. Use 0 for automatic detection (recommended).

max_concurrent_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client TCP connections to accept.

packetcache_size.description: Maximum number of entries in the packet cache (queries for identical records are served from cache).

packetcache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) for entries in the packet cache (seconds).

block_domains.description: List of domains or patterns to block via query-time filtering (e.g., ['ads.example.com', '*.doubleclick.net']).

allow_from.description: CIDR ranges allowed to send queries to this resolver (security risk if too permissive).

forward_zones.description: List of zone → resolver mappings for forwarding specific domains (e.g., [{'zone': 'example.com', 'resolver': '8.8.8.8'}]).

zone.description: Domain or subdomain to forward (e.g., 'example.com' or '.' for all).

resolver.description: IP address or list of IPs to forward to (e.g., '8.8.8.8' or '1.1.1.1,9.9.9.9').

dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC validation of responses (recommended for security).

logfile.description: Path to write log output (empty = log to stderr).

query_log_file.description: Path for the query log (if enabled).

query_log.description: Enable logging of every query (use with care — can be very verbose).

query_local_address_timeout.description: Timeout for detecting the local address to use for outgoing queries (seconds).

neg_cache_ttl.description: TTL for negative responses (NXDOMAIN/NODATA) in seconds.

query_local_address.description: Local source address for outgoing queries (use 'auto' for automatic selection).

dns64.description: Enable DNS64 (synthesizing AAAA records from A records for IPv6-only clients).

dns64_prefix.description: Prefix used for synthesized IPv6 addresses (RFC 6052 / RFC 6147).

edns_subnet_processing.description: Enable EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) processing to preserve client location info upstream.

edns_subnet_allow.description: Maximum subnet mask width for IPv4 ECS (e.g., 24 = /24). Set to 0 to disable IPv4.

rate_limit.description: Maximum queries per second per source IP (0 = unlimited).

slip_rate_limit.description: Max number of queries to 'slip' (ignore) before rate-limiting kicks in.

api.description: Enable the control API (for pdns_control and external tools).

api_key.description: Base64-encoded secret key for API authentication (required if API enabled).

api_listen.description: Interface for API listener (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

api_port.description: Port for the API (must match webserver-port if webserver enabled).

webserver.description: Enable the embedded webserver (serves stats, API, and admin interface).

webserver_port.description: Port for the webserver (same as api_port when using unified server).

webserver_password.description: Password for webserver auth (if set; otherwise API key is used).

local_zones.description: Local zone definitions (e.g., for split DNS or internal zones).

local_data.description: Static DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, etc.) for local zones.

type.description: RR type: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, etc.

serve_rfc1918.description: Whether to respond to queries for RFC 1918 (private) reverse zones (e.g., 10.in-addr.arpa).

packet_cache.description: Enable the packet cache (cache entire DNS responses).

max_qps_per_ip.description: Maximum queries per second per source IP (0 = no limit).

cpu_affinity.description: CPU core affinity (0 = none, 1 = pin to core 0, etc.).

stub_resolver.description: Enable stub resolver mode (use /etc/resolv.conf for initial resolution).
